No local facility or custody statute documented, but patterned lethal violence: two trans women fatally shot in a week, three investigations, police calling it epidemic-level — acknowledged yet unresolved; adult care also withdrawn.

No local hostile legislation, listed on July 2026 low-risk assessment for largely refraining from targeting trans adults; exposure is national-layer only plus a legislature-imposed facilities restriction of unspecified scope and protest arrests.
